name: integrations_hris_field_preview
description: Preview what an HRIS field would give before choosing it as the source of an Org Graph level or fact. For target "level": the units it would create, with their labels and how many people fall in each, largest first. For a fact ("cost_centre", "country"): how many people have a value and how many would change from what the Org Graph holds now. Both count people the field is blank for and people whose record withholds it. Reads the HRIS live; writes nothing.
